architectureRuling.law: docs/architecture/core/Spine-TypeScript-and-Patterns.md § Types & schemas — one home, one direction, no inline
architectureRuling.judgment: Preserve the repo standard: cross-boundary wire shapes are Zod plus inferred TypeScript by default. Hand-authored twins are deliberate exceptions when the canonical type lives elsewhere, recursive lazy inference breaks, Biome cannot reason through the inferred union, or a nominal brand is authoritative. Do not migrate them wholesale or move ownership across package layers.
confirmedExamples: TagFolderType is tuple-derived because Biome misjudges exhaustive switch reachability through the Zod-inferred type.
PluginSurfaceNode is a recursive lazy union whose declared type remains authoritative for Biome reachability.
VarOp and MacroFreeze are kit-owned canonical types with contract-owned validation mirrors.
Branded ID schemas validate input into canonical nominal types.
